estimand: Mean within-participant C2 minus C1 difference for each scored scale.
assumptions: Participants are the resampling units; paired differences are exchangeable for the percentile bootstrap.
diagnostics: Paired n, bootstrap interval, original exact signed-rank p, and Holm-adjusted p.
limitations: Only eight participants; bootstrap intervals may have poor coverage. Holm adjustment is conservative and exploratory.

estimand: C2:C1 time ratio among participant-case pairs appearing in both conditions; separately, observed case mix and first presentations.
assumptions: Matched cases are comparable across conditions; log ratios are meaningful. This overlap estimand applies only to matched pairs.
diagnostics: Matched-pair count and participant coverage, per-pair and per-participant ratios, case-specific coverage, first-presentation summaries.
limitations: Sparse overlap, order/block confounding, unequal case allocation, and repeated exposures limit generalization and causal interpretation.

estimand: Observed exact or band agreement rates, shown case-weighted and participant-weighted, with a first-presentation sensitivity.
assumptions: Recorded assistant and participant categories and the documented bands are accurate; rates describe this sample only.
diagnostics: Raw numerators/denominators, number of participants, weighting comparison, and first-presentation sensitivity.
limitations: No clinical reference standard; participant clusters and cases are too few for dependable cluster-robust inference or complex mixed models.
